summary: Lanvin Group filed a 6-K disclosing that the NYSE determined to delist the company's warrants (LANV-WT) due to abnormally low selling price under Section 802.01D. Trading is suspended immediately; the NYSE will apply to the SEC to complete the delisting. The action does not affect the company's ordinary shares (LANV), which continue trading. No price, premium, or advisor terms are mentioned. This is a NYSE-initiated involuntary delisting of warrants only. Watch for the SEC's response and whether any shareholder litigation or conversion rights arise.
